_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what Aperture can actually do today. The validator (scripts/validate-pitch.mjs) enforces that only genuinely-shipping capabilities are marked "live". Do not set status:"live" on anything that is not in production. Allowed live set: Synthetic Data Generation, Domain Adaptation.

layer.name: Aperture reasoning layer
layer.note: auto-ranks root causes and the mAP each fix is worth

engines.name: Synthetic Data Generation
engines.one_liner: Generate the exact frames your dataset is missing — night, rain, glare, rare classes — with pixel-accurate labels.
engines.input: a target class + condition (e.g. cyclist @ night)
engines.output: labelled RGB frames, COCO/YOLO json, versioned
engines.proof: +11.4 mAP pts on night+rain pilot eval

engines.name: Domain Adaptation
engines.one_liner: Retarget a labelled daytime set into the domain you actually deploy in — no re-shoot, no re-label.
engines.input: a labelled source domain + target frames
engines.proof: 2-day manual pipeline down to a 40-minute run
